title: Constructive Lean 4 Kernel and Exact-Rational Certificates for Google Research Cogentic's O(r^(1/2 - 5e-6)) Log-Rank Conjecture Proof
abstract: Google Research's Cogentic framework (Nov. 25, 2026) broke the sqrt(r) barrier for the Lovasz-Saks Log-Rank Conjecture, proving that every rank-r Boolean matrix M in {0,1}^{X x Y} has a monochromatic rectangle of density >= 2^{-C r^{1/2-eps}} and deterministic communication complexity D_cc(M) <= C' r^{1/2-eps} with eps = 5e-6, C = 238, and C' = 750 C = 178,500. We deliver an explicitly scoped, standalone, zero-floating-point verification stack for the deterministic algebraic, third-moment spectral-tensor, Bregman-divergence, monochromatic rank-split, and quantitative Nisan-Wigderson recursion pillars of this breakthrough. Layer 1 (CogenticLogRank.lean) proves 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 4 zero-axiom and 14 [propext, Quot.sound]) mechanizing Eq. (1.6) pointwise Booleanity, the degree-1 AM-GM barrier vs. degree-2 cosh-tilt lambda^2-cancellation, Eq. (1.7) variational penalty concavity/slope, scalar/eigenvalue Eq. (2.2) Bregman nonnegativity, the 2x2 commutator trace identity, inductive Lemma 2.1(1) leverage defect, universal 2D Hermite c_2 covariance, and every discrete step of Proposition A.3 (2^11 < 3^7, 3*29^4 < 4*27^4, rank-split floor(3k/4), 750 C_0). Layer 2 (LOGRANK-COGENTIC-CERT-1.0) is a pure-stdlib Python Fraction auditor across four modes that certifies 16 canonical witnesses in 0.099-16.937 ms—including an exact isospectral separation between Boolean S = J_4 - 2I_4 (E_3 = 3/2, hollow slice energy 3/32) and the Rademacher barrier A_Rad (E_3 = 0, hollow energy 0)—and rejects 62/62 live adversarial forgeries with exact branch assertions (66/66 pytest checks).
